umrah_hero_tagline: What it means, what it earns, and how it is performed — step by step.
umrah_meaning_lead: Umrah is a visit to the Sacred House of Allah in Makkah, performed in a state of ihram. Unlike Hajj it is not tied to fixed days, so it may be undertaken at any time of the year.
umrah_meaning_linguistic_body: The word 'umrah comes from a root meaning to visit, and specifically to visit a place that is inhabited and cared for.
umrah_meaning_shariah_body: To worship Allah by entering ihram, making tawaf around the Ka'bah, walking the sa'i between Safa and Marwah, and then shaving or trimming the hair.
umrah_pillars_subtitle: Leave any of these out and the Umrah is not valid.
umrah_pillar_ihram_hint: Entered at the miqat, with the intention in the heart.
umrah_pillar_tawaf_hint: Seven circuits of the Ka'bah, starting at the Black Stone.
umrah_pillar_sai_hint: Seven trips between Safa and Marwah, ending at Marwah.
umrah_pillar_halq_hint: Shaving or trimming the hair, which releases you from ihram.
umrah_virtues_subtitle: What the Prophet ﷺ promised those who make the journey.
umrah_virtue_1_title: It wipes out what came before it
umrah_virtue_1_body: The Prophet ﷺ said that one Umrah until the next is an expiation for whatever falls between them.
umrah_virtue_2_title: In Ramadan it weighs as a Hajj
umrah_virtue_2_body: He ﷺ told a woman who missed the Hajj that an Umrah performed in Ramadan equals a Hajj in reward.
umrah_virtue_3_title: It drives out poverty and sin
umrah_virtue_3_body: He ﷺ said to follow one with the other, for together they remove poverty and sins the way a blacksmith's bellows removes impurity from iron.
umrah_virtue_4_title: You travel as a guest of Allah
umrah_virtue_4_body: Those performing Hajj and Umrah are described as the delegation of Allah: if they call on Him He answers, and if they seek His forgiveness He forgives them.
umrah_virtue_5_title: Every prayer there counts many times over
umrah_virtue_5_body: A single prayer offered in the Sacred Mosque is reported to be better than a hundred thousand prayers offered anywhere else.
umrah_virtue_6_title: It is the jihad of those who cannot fight
umrah_virtue_6_body: When Aisha asked whether women were required to fight, he ﷺ answered that their jihad is Hajj and Umrah.
umrah_steps_subtitle: Performed in this order, from the miqat to the trimming of the hair.
umrah_prohibitions_subtitle: These apply from the moment you enter ihram until your hair is cut.
umrah_azkar_hint: Every supplication narrated for the rites, with a counter.
umrah_review_notice: Rulings and supplications here are drawn from the Qur'an and the collections of Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud and Ibn Majah, with the source shown on each step. Where the schools differ, that is noted rather than hidden. This guide has not been checked by a scholar — if something conflicts with what your imam or group leader tells you on the ground, follow them.

umrah_azkar_subtitle: Supplications narrated for the rites of Umrah
ihram_action_1: Perform ghusl if you are able, or wudu at minimum.
ihram_action_2: Men: two unstitched white cloths, one around the waist and one over the shoulders, with the head left uncovered. Women: ordinary modest clothing — there is no special garment.
ihram_action_3: Apply perfume to the body before entering ihram, not to the garments.
ihram_action_4: Enter ihram at or before the miqat. If flying, this usually means changing on the plane before the announcement.
ihram_action_5: Make the intention in your heart, then state it.
ihram_dua_1_translation: O Allah, I intend to perform Umrah, so make it easy for me and accept it from me.
ihram_dua_1_reference: Wording of the intention; the intention itself is of the heart
ihram_caution: Passing the miqat without ihram when you intended Umrah requires going back to it, or otherwise a compensation. Enter ihram before you reach it, not after.
ihram_reference: Bukhari and Muslim, on the mawaqit
talbiyah_action_1: Begin the talbiyah immediately after entering ihram.
talbiyah_action_2: Repeat it often — travelling, on arrival, in the streets of Makkah.
talbiyah_action_3: Men raise the voice; women say it quietly.
talbiyah_action_4: Stop the talbiyah when you begin tawaf.
talbiyah_dua_1_translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. All praise and favour are Yours, and all dominion. You have no partner.
talbiyah_dua_1_virtue: Recited continuously from ihram until tawaf begins.
entering_haram_action_1: Enter with the right foot first and say the du'a for entering a mosque.
entering_haram_action_2: On first seeing the Ka'bah, supplicate for whatever you wish — this is a moment where du'a is hoped to be answered.
entering_haram_dua_1_translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
entering_haram_caution: The widely-shared du'a said to be for "first sight of the Ka'bah" is not established from the Prophet ﷺ. Supplicate freely in your own words instead.
tawaf_action_1: Begin at the Black Stone with the Ka'bah on your left, and circle anticlockwise.
tawaf_action_2: At each circuit, face the Black Stone and say "Bismillah, Allahu Akbar". Kiss it if you can reach it without crowding others; otherwise touch it, or simply point to it from a distance.
tawaf_action_3: Men: uncover the right shoulder (idtiba') for the whole tawaf, and walk briskly (raml) for the first three circuits only.
tawaf_action_4: Seven circuits, each starting and ending at the Black Stone.
tawaf_dua_1_translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
tawaf_dua_1_reference: Qur'an 2:201; Abu Dawud, said between the Yemeni corner and the Black Stone
tawaf_caution: There is NO supplication prescribed for each individual circuit. The booklets that assign one per round have no basis. Ibn Taymiyyah: no particular dhikr for tawaf was narrated from the Prophet ﷺ — supplicate with whatever you wish from the Qur'an and Sunnah, or in your own language.
maqam_action_1: After the seventh circuit, pray two rak'ah with the Maqam between you and the Ka'bah if there is room.
maqam_action_2: Recite al-Kafirun in the first rak'ah and al-Ikhlas in the second.
maqam_action_3: If the area is crowded, pray anywhere in the mosque. Do not push.
maqam_dua_1_translation: And take the station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer.
maqam_reference: Muslim, in the hadith of Jabir on the Prophet's Hajj
zamzam_action_1: Drink your fill of Zamzam and supplicate for what you need.
zamzam_action_2: The Prophet ﷺ said Zamzam is for whatever it is drunk for.
sai_action_1: Go to Safa. On approaching it, recite the verse below.
sai_action_2: Face the qiblah, raise your hands, and say the dhikr three times, supplicating between each.
sai_action_3: Walk to Marwah — that is one trip. Marwah back to Safa is the second. Seven trips in total, ending at Marwah.
sai_action_4: Men jog between the two green markers; women walk throughout.
sai_dua_1_translation: Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.
sai_dua_2_translation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is capable of all things.
sai_dua_2_reference: Muslim; said facing the qiblah on Safa and on Marwah
sai_caution: As with tawaf, no supplication is prescribed for each individual trip. Say what you wish.
sai_reference: Muslim, in the hadith of Jabir
halq_action_1: Men: shave the head completely (halq), which carries the greater reward, or trim it evenly (taqsir).
halq_action_2: Women: gather the hair and trim about a fingertip's length from the end. Women do not shave.
halq_action_3: With this the Umrah is complete and the restrictions of ihram lift.
halq_caution: Trim from all around the head, not a token snip from one side.
prohibition_3: Marriage contracts, and intimacy of any kind
prohibition_5: Men: stitched clothing, and covering the head
prohibition_6: Women: covering the face with a niqab, or wearing gloves — though the face may be covered loosely when non-mahram men are present, which the schools discuss differently
dhikr_ayat_kursi: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
dhikr_ikhlas: Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent.'
dhikr_falaq: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies.'
dhikr_nas: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the whispering invidious - Who whispers [evil] into the chests of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind.'
dhikr_morning_dominion: We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things competent.
dhikr_evening_dominion: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things competent.
dhikr_sayyid_istighfar: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am upon Your covenant and your promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for indeed none forgives sins except You.
dhikr_protection: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing can cause harm neither on earth nor in the heavens, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
dhikr_contentment: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet.
dhikr_subhanallah_bihamdih: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him.
dhikr_unit_praise: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things competent.
dhikr_evening_entry: O Allah, by You we have reached the evening, and by You we have reached the morning, and by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
dhikr_perfect_words: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created.
dhikr_wellbeing: O Allah, grant me health in my body. O Allah, grant me health in my hearing. O Allah, grant me health in my sight. There is no deity except You.
dhikr_astaghfirullah_repent: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I repent to Him.
dhikr_tasleem: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace, blessed are You, O Owner of majesty and honor.
dhikr_withhold: O Allah, none can withhold what You have given, and none can give what You have withheld.
dhikr_help_worship: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in an excellent manner.
dhikr_sleep_bismika: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
dhikr_sleep_protection: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
dhikr_sleep_submit: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You, and entrusted my affair to You, and turned my back to You out of hope for and fear of You. There is no refuge nor safe haven from You except with You.
dhikr_waking_praise: Praise be to Allah who has given us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
dhikr_distress_magnificent: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
dhikr_yunus: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
dhikr_hasbunallah: Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.
dhikr_mercy_hope: O Allah, for Your mercy I hope, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye. Correct for me all of my affairs. There is no deity except You.
dhikr_la_hawla: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
dhikr_subhanallahi_azim: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, glory is to Allah the Magnificent.
dhikr_astaghfirullah_azim: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, the Magnificent, and I repent to Him.
dhikr_durood: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Indeed You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.
dhikr_morning_entry: O Allah, by You we have reached the morning, and by You we have reached the evening, and by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
dhikr_fitrah: We have reached the morning upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, who was upright, a Muslim, and was not of those who associate partners with Allah.
dhikr_pardon_wellbeing: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth.
dhikr_ya_hayyu: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Set right all my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
dhikr_subhanallah_count: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him, as many as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.
dhikr_beneficial_knowledge: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision, and deeds that are accepted.
dhikr_virtue_after_kursi: Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing stands between him and entering Paradise except death.
dhikr_virtue_morning: Whoever recites this in the morning is protected from harm until the evening.
dhikr_virtue_evening: Whoever recites this in the evening is protected from harm until the morning.
dhikr_virtue_istighfar: Whoever says this during the day with firm belief in it and dies on that day before the evening, he will be from the people of Paradise.
dhikr_virtue_tasbih: Whoever says this 100 times a day, his sins will be forgiven even if they were like the foam of the sea.
dhikr_virtue_after_prayer: Whoever glorifies Allah, praises Him, and magnifies Him after every prayer will have their sins forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.
dhikr_virtue_general: These two phrases are light on the tongue, heavy on the scales, and beloved to the Most Merciful.
